rasterOnDark.note: white wordmark, red and teal interlocking O, transparent. Preferred for exports.

rasterOnLight.note: dark wordmark on a white square. Only on white or paper.

master.svgWarning: The SVG wordmarks are live <text> in Georgia, not outlines. On a machine without Georgia the letters change shape. For exported images use the PNG files.
master.clearSpace: the height of the tallest tower on every side

raita.note: white R with a red excavator, for dark backgrounds

shchinta.note: round badge, works on light and dark

afik.note: thin white AH monogram, dark backgrounds only

rules: Never stretch, recolor, rotate, outline or put a shadow on a logo. Scale proportionally only.
One master logo per design. A division logo may sit next to it as an endorsement, smaller.
Never put the Afik Hanahal logo on a construction post, or the Ra'ita logo on a brokerage post.
